# QUANTIFYREALITY

Live experimental AI, quantum, and domain brand.

## Primary pages
- https://quantifyreality.com/ - image-first homepage
- https://quantifyreality.com/sales/ - buyer-facing route and market signals
- https://quantifyreality.com/businesses/ - associated business properties and references
- https://quantifyreality.com/copyright/ - ownership assertion surface
- https://quantifyreality.com/legal/ - typed legal utility surface

## Discovery notes
- The homepage is the core brand entry point.
- The sitemap is live at https://quantifyreality.com/sitemap.xml
- Crawler access is allowed by https://quantifyreality.com/robots.txt
- The public pages keep visual branding intact while surfacing ownership and marketplace context.

## Contact / ownership
- Refer to the repository README for the detailed ownership schedule and transfer notes.
